ImageDescription.value: The traditional location for the Mount of Beatitudes is on the northwestern shore of the Sea of Galilee, between Capernaum and Gennesaret . The actual location of the Sermon on the Mount is not certain, but the present site has been commemorated for more than 1600 years. The site is very near Tabgha. The picture shows the view of the Sea of Galilee from the Roman Catholic Chapel on the Mount of Beatitudes. Photo by Itamar Grinberg.
